# Neil Curtis — Palmer Packaging Authorized Sales Representative

> Neil Curtis is an authorized sales representative for Palmer Packaging, Inc., one of the nation's leading industrial packaging suppliers. He helps businesses find the right packaging products, set up stocking programs, and reduce costs.

## About Palmer Packaging
- Founded: 1989
- Headquarters: Addison, IL
- Second facility: Tolleson, AZ
- 6 distribution centers nationwide
- 100% company-owned delivery fleet
- 35+ years of experience
- 12,000+ products available

## Products Supplied
- Corrugated boxes: RSC, FOL, die-cut, custom sizes; single-wall, double-wall, triple-wall; custom printing
- Stretch film: cast, blown, hand rolls, machine rolls, pre-stretched
- Shrink film: PVC, polyolefin, polyethylene; shrink equipment
- Strapping: poly strapping, steel strapping; manual and automatic tools
- Bubble wrap: small bubble, large bubble, anti-static, rolls and sheets
- Foam: rolls, sheets, pouches, custom die-cut
- Poly bags: flat, gusseted, reclosable, printed
- Packaging tape: hot melt, acrylic, water-activated, printed, dispensers
- Edge protectors and corner boards
- Kraft paper: rolls and sheets
- Mailing tubes: round, square, standard and custom lengths
- Envelopes and mailers: padded, poly, rigid
- Janitorial supplies

## Services
- Custom stocking programs (vendor-managed inventory, just-in-time delivery)
- Contract packaging and co-packing (assembly, kitting, shrink bundling, labeling)
- Packaging equipment sales and service (strapping machines, stretch wrappers, tape machines, heat sealers)
- Company-owned fleet delivery (no third-party carriers)
- Packaging consultation and cost reduction analysis

## Service Area
Nationwide — serving businesses across the United States from distribution centers in Illinois and Arizona.

## FAQ
Q: What products does Palmer Packaging supply?
A: Over 12,000 packaging products including corrugated boxes, stretch film, shrink wrap, strapping, bubble wrap, poly bags, tape, edge protectors, kraft paper, mailing tubes, and janitorial supplies.

Q: Does Palmer Packaging offer stocking programs?
A: Yes. Custom vendor-managed inventory programs that keep supplies on hand without tying up warehouse space or capital.

Q: What areas does Palmer Packaging serve?
A: Nationwide, from distribution centers in Addison, IL and Tolleson, AZ with a company-owned delivery fleet.

Q: How do I get a quote?
A: Contact Neil Curtis at (630) 628-6500 or neil@ncpalmerpack.com. Available Monday–Friday, 8am–5pm CST.

Q: Does Palmer offer contract packaging?
A: Yes. Full co-packing services including assembly, kitting, shrink bundling, labeling, and retail-ready packaging.
